list.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills

extra.desc: FlowEvo enables large language model agents to co-evolve reusable skills and workflows during inference, improving accuracy and efficiency across diverse benchmarks.

list.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity

extra.desc: TinyCast is a compact, attention-free zero-shot forecaster that uses spectral period detection and dilated convolutions to emit predictive distributions with minimal parameters and embedded-device compatibility.

list.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?

extra.desc: Large language models and dedicated embedding models achieve nearly identical aggregate performance across diverse tasks, but embedding models are far cheaper and faster, supporting a division of labor by task type.

list.title: τ_0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation

extra.desc: A hierarchical vision-language-action model improves long-horizon robot manipulation by using world-model-guided test-time search to scale computation for high-level subtask decisions.

list.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures

extra.desc: QuoteBench reveals that execution-boundary parsing errors significantly reduce LLM coding agent success, and disclosing the boundary helps recover performance, showing that evaluation must account for deployment configuration rather than treating matched scores as intrinsic model properties.

list.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses

extra.desc: Hierarchical Self-Improvement evolves task-specific execution harnesses for frozen LLM agents via hierarchical self-modification, yielding substantial gains on moderate tasks while being bounded by feedback quality and backbone limits.

list.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation

extra.desc: GOAG is an object-agnostic deep generative grasp planner that learns a gripper-specific contact surface distribution to sample valid grasps for unseen objects without object-specific training.

list.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning

extra.desc: CoToGrasp is a generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps conditioned on specific contact topologies using an object-agnostic, gripper-centric workspace for zero-shot generalization.

list.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See

extra.desc: Fine-tuning large mixture-of-experts models on a low-resource language shifts reasoning into that language without harming accuracy, while reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fixes formatting and leakage defects.

list.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video

extra.desc: NARU is a Japanese long-form video benchmark evaluating narrative evolution and cultural reasoning through a hierarchical annotation pipeline and extensive native-speaker verification.

list.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners

extra.desc: NAPE uses causal Transformers to predict successive spectrogram patch embeddings for self-supervised audio learning without auxiliary components.

list.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models

extra.desc: High-performing speech recognition models reproduce benchmark transcripts despite contradictory audio, revealing benchmark-optimized behaviors that inflate scores without improving real-world transcription.

list.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?

extra.desc: SWE-bench Science benchmarks coding agents on scientific software repair, revealing failure mechanisms and mixed effects of scientific guidance.

list.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement

extra.desc: Large language models improve continuously through iterative test-time feedback loops called Chain-of-Experience, outperforming zero-shot baselines with lower cost and higher token efficiency.

list.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving

extra.desc: FlashPrefill V2 improves long-context serving via mean-corrected sparse attention, optimized GPU operators, and framework integration, achieving large speedups over dense baselines.

list.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback

extra.desc: SkillEvo improves agent skills through multi-turn feedback and active governance to sustain evolution gradients.

list.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation

extra.desc: Repo0 uses a dual-graph architectural state and modularity-guided structural evolution to generate complete software repositories from natural-language requirements with high functionality coverage.

list.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization

extra.desc: IAR is a three-stage post-training framework that injects structured document knowledge into language models, aligns them for retrieval-free question answering, and recovers general capabilities, improving both domain accuracy and general performance.

list.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video

extra.desc: 4DAnyone reconstructs 4D humans from monocular video by generating multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting, using reference and target context designs to overcome scaling bottlenecks.

list.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use

extra.desc: Retrieved memories can induce reasoning errors and belief distortions in large language models, and an inference-time strategy helps avoid these cognitive traps while maintaining benchmark performance.

list.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models

extra.desc: ForgeWM progressively distills bidirectional video generators into efficient few-step interactive world models with aligned discrete and continuous controls, supporting low-latency interaction and replay-time refinement.

list.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation

extra.desc: WithEveryone enables reliable identity-preserving group image generation for up to ten people by grounding identities to layout plans and using region-based identity losses.

list.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis

extra.desc: FACET constructs executable terminal tasks by preserving source intent and grounding instructions, solutions, and verifiers in a shared repaired environment to enable scalable agent training.

list.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

extra.desc: EnvHarness and EnvRigger dynamically reshape static environments via programmable plugins to target agent weaknesses and improve reinforcement learning co-evolution.

list.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies

extra.desc: EXIMO efficiently fine-tunes large vision-language-action robot policies by combining VLM-guided exploration, imitation on orchestrated data, and residual off-policy reinforcement learning.

list.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents

extra.desc: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an age

list.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation

extra.desc: A human-aligned chain-of-thought reward model and preference dataset improve joint video-audio generation by replacing fragmented metrics with coherent, dimension-wise reinforcement learning.

list.title: Evaluating Music Context Preservation: A Multi-facet Framework for Music Editing Systems

extra.desc: The study introduces MuseCPEval, a framework with tailored metrics to evaluate preservation of unchanged musical attributes during editing tasks.

list.title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion

extra.desc: RapidLiDAR learns adaptive spatial displacements to initialize LiDAR scenes and refines them via multi-scale voxel and BEV features for real-time completion.

list.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection

extra.desc: Structured Prior Knowledge explicitly extracts latent semantic, geometric, and contextual priors from pretrained object detectors to detect out-of-distribution hallucinations via a compact interpretable representation.

list.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data

extra.desc: HOTFIXR is a data generation framework that targets multilingual reasoning weaknesses to improve cross-lingual performance without sacrificing overall capability.

list.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems

extra.desc: The Agentic Principal Chain enforces session-aware authorization checks to prevent harmful action combinations and delegation abuses in LLM agents.

list.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

extra.desc: SkillGate fixes selector credit starvation in agent skill selection by separating outcome credit for execution tokens from local advantage for skill-naming tokens, improving success rates and reducing misleading skill exposure.

list.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning

extra.desc: AdaPop adapts gradient pressure by fact popularity and automates forget-retain balance to reduce leakage of unlearned content.

list.title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection

extra.desc: Hallucination is detected as temporally extended spans via sequence labeling over fused external features, achieving robust cross-model performance without internal model access.

list.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL

extra.desc: Co-RL enables unsupervised reasoning via cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with peer-derived rewards, improving performance across text and vision tasks without ground-truth labels.

list.title: Scaling Creative Writing Beyond Story-Centric Data with Attribute-Guided Genre Expansion

extra.desc: A framework that separates thematic seeds from genre-form controls generates diverse, high-quality creative writing data across 13 genres and improves LLM creative writing performance.

list.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist

extra.desc: OmniScientist is an end-to-end omni-modal AI scientist that performs multidisciplinary research directly from heterogeneous raw evidence using autonomous agents and lifecycle-wide perception, improving evidence-grounded discovery across diverse scientific modalities.

list.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence

extra.desc: Zetta is a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves runtime critics and recovery skills online to govern physical execution at action frequency, achieving high success on robot benchmarks with faster inference and scaling self-exploration.

list.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning

extra.desc: Action-conditioned objectives improve latent geometry for Euclidean-cost model-predictive control by enhancing decision-metric alignment in world models.

list.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation

extra.desc: SoftVTBench introduces a synchronized visuo-tactile dataset and deformation-aware benchmark for evaluating physical interaction quality during deformable-object manipulation.

list.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation

extra.desc: Semantic task completion video generation evaluates whether generated videos achieve intended outcomes with semantic grounding, supported by a curated dataset and vision-language model-based benchmark.

list.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification

extra.desc: Compatible open-weight language model checkpoints share detectable weight-space ancestry signals that distinguish true lineage from independent or distilled models without requiring data.

list.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis

extra.desc: Top-K prompting and plausibility-aware training improve diverse reaction prediction in single-step retrosynthesis, yielding state-of-the-art results on a large verified reaction dataset and motivating ensemble systems.

list.title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation

extra.desc: SemaPLC is a verification-gated agent harness that validates generated PLC logic through external compilation and live runtime execution, achieving higher verified pass rates than baseline methods.

list.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

extra.desc: SPADE is a self-play reinforcement learning framework where a language model designs adaptive executable training environments and learns to solve them, improving reasoning and tool-use performance through regret-based environment targeting.

list.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling

extra.desc: Looped language models improve compositional, multi-step tool use through recurrent computation, with adaptive inference balancing accuracy and compute cost.

list.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents

extra.desc: FM-Bench evaluates long-horizon decision-making of LLM agents managing a football club over 20 years, revealing that managerial behavior rather than scale or token spend drives performance.

list.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution

extra.desc: SkillForge improves automated software issue resolution by synthesizing repository-specific issues and distilling reusable skills from them before encountering real bugs.

list.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery

extra.desc: A literature-to-review pipeline automates problem discovery and triage to focus expert review on promising mathematical conjectures within a chosen research direction.
